sloka: कृत्वा शाप समायुक्तान् पुत्रान् मुनिवरः तदा ।शुनःशेपम् उवाच आर्तम् कृत्वा रक्षाम् निरामयाम् ॥१-६२-१८॥
transliteration: kṛtvā śāpa samāyuktān putrān munivaraḥ tadā ।śunaḥśepam uvāca ārtam kṛtvā rakṣām nirāmayām ॥1-62-18॥

translations.english: Viswamitra the best of ascetics, thus cursed his sons. Sunassepha, (now) was filled with distress. To relieve him of his pain he said:
